name: J01 MW-AUTHOR — the native client against a real product and a real provider
about: The acceptance J01 actually owes: launch the SHIPPED native terminal client
against the accepted Rust product, select project, agent and model before
chatting, stream a REAL external response, and reopen the same Session.
The product here is configured against the campaign's real provider, in a
service root of this campaign's own — no fixture provider, no contract
double, no other campaign's preserved store.
The prompt is deliberately small and tool-free. It is a real completion,
billed like any other, and the acceptance is that the client streams it and
can reopen it, not that the model says anything in particular.
`expect` waits are generous here because a real provider takes real time,
and they are still a bounded count of fixed polls with no clock read.
The waits target `[text]` — the transcript's own slice marker — and never
the prompt words. An earlier revision waited for `canary`, which the
COMPOSER also contains while the prompt is being typed, so the run passed
on its own echo before the model had answered. An expectation a screen can
satisfy without the product doing anything is not an expectation.
